import openpyxl, os
in_x=os.environ['IN_XLSX']; out_x=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out_x)
inp=wb['Input']; out=wb['Output']
# Output row N maps to Input row N-2 (A11=Input!A9 ... A34=Input!A32)
for n in range(11,35):
    ir=n-2
    e=inp.cell(row=ir,column=5).value
    b=inp.cell(row=ir,column=2).value
    if e is not None and str(e).strip().lower()=='yes' and b is not None and str(b).strip()!='':
        out.cell(row=n,column=2).value=b
    else:
        out.cell(row=n,column=2).value=None
wb.save(out_x)
print('done')
